data.body: AC amendment (gap-analysis): alert_store API is append(record, repo_root) NOT write(kind, dict). Per-issue dedup must call: alert_store.append({'alert': 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed', 'key': <jira_key>, ...}, repo_root). Keep the grep for 'fetcher-dedup-suppressed' string; update the AC grep for 'alert_store' to match the append() call site.
